C0906.title: Multiple Defendants Sentenced for Forging and Trafficking Fraudulent Household Registration Identity Information in Liangshan, Sichuan
C0906.summary: Between 2016 and 2019, ten defendants including Lin Haiyan and Zhong Xiujuan colluded with multiple household registration officers from the Ganluo County Public Security Bureau in Sichuan. They forged, altered, and traded resident identity cards and household registration booklets for 49 individuals by fraudulently using frozen or relocated household registration quotas. Buyers included judgment
